notes.title: Symphony of Delights – Artbook + OST – 50% Off
notes.content:
[h1]The unseen and the unheard — the very soul of Symphony of Delights — is now yours.[/h1]
[h2]The Artbook and Original Soundtrack are 50% off until June 2.
[/h2]
The Artbook unveils the invisible: raw sketches, textures of desire, unfinished lines, and the ritual behind the creation of this dreamlike symphony.

The Original Soundtrack captures the breath between the notes — melodies of seduction, silence as tension, harmonies woven with longing, mystery, and surrender.
It’s a soundscape that lingers long after the last note fades.

[h3]But even as you immerse yourself in these echoes...
A new fugue has already begun.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39562293/514f78050df2e511e0a9fc356768618aae2a0230.png[/img]
It’s only a murmur.
A line.
A forgotten sketch left behind — a prelude to what’s yet to be revealed.

[h1]The Dream shifts. The next movement approaches.[/h1]

notes.title: Symphony of Delights – 50% Off
notes.content:
[h1]Symphony of Delights is now 50% off until June 2.[/h1]

A symphony where every note is temptation, every silence is a wound, and every crescendo leads deeper into the labyrinth of desire.
This is not merely music — it is a ritual of seduction woven into the very fabric of the Dream.

Here, your choices are melodies. Your surrender, the harmony.
And as the echoes of this symphony linger...
A new fugue is beginning to resonate.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39562293/26d84b4e443ac0103a03811e86e5244054545a15.png[/img]
You may sense it — but only as a shadow between notes.
A forgotten sketch. A whisper of something still unfinished... but inevitable.

[h2]The Dream trembles. Something new is coming.[/h2]

notes.title: Symphony DLCs — The First Touch, Frozen and Heard (50% off)
notes.content:
[i]There’s something sacred about the first time.
The first breath between scenes.
The first frame that held too much skin.
The first sound that made you close your eyes.[/i]

This week, the Symphony of Delights OST and Artbook return — 50% off — for those who want to carry the beginning in their hands.

 [h3]The Original Soundtrack[/h3] is a lofi ritual: hand-composed, sound-font textured, and tuned for private moments. These are not loops — they’re phrases. The rhythm of erotic myth, delivered with restraint and pulse.

 [h3]The Artbook is a vault of origins.[/h3]
Rough lines, bold ink, first visions.
Pages where Elylah and Vulpes began to exist — before they were even sure they were being watched.

Together, they hold the intimacy of early mistakes, bold choices, and sacred invention.
They are not polished.
They are true.


[h3]Nearly 1,000 dreamers have stepped into Symphony.[/h3]
Now you can take a piece of it with you — and keep playing its melody in silence.


[h3]The fugue is coming.[/h3]
But even the most dangerous symphony begins in quiet breath.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39562293/b615e9827c10366c7bf9b45538b25cff64fd2544.png[/img]

notes.title: ymphony of Delights — Where the First Moan Echoed (50% off)
notes.content:
[i]You never forget the first time.
The first sigh. The first fall.
The first time you touched Elylah — or she touched you.[/i]

Symphony of Delights is the origin of the Enygmage saga.
It’s shorter, more primal, more dreamlike. A fusion of erotic myth, visual poetry, and surreal tension.

[h3]Here, you’ll witness:[/h3]

[list]
[*] The spark between Elylah and Vulpes

[*] The theft of the mystic keys

[*] The first erotic fantasies told inside the Dreamrealm

[*] And the ancient beginnings of the world you now inhabit
[/list]

 It’s rougher. Cruder. And exactly because of that — it's sacred.
 Every saga has a pulse. This is where ours began.

 [h3]Now 50% off this week.[/h3]

 [h3]Over 1,000 players have already crossed this gate.[/h3]
 But many are still watching from the threshold.

Are you ready to remember what started it all?


[h3]A new chapter is forming.[/h3]
Something darker, more deliberate, more dangerous.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39562293/c08c4a95283bc2acad782144c8a3181704eb34d3.png[/img]

[b]Elylah is changing.[/b]

 And for those who want to hold the myth in silence, [b]the illustrated book is nearing completion.[/b]

Begin again.
Or begin for the first time.
[b]The Symphony still plays.[/b]
